responsibility: This source file implements NDS32 interrupt, exception, and reset handler support at the compiler/assembler-output boundary. It parses handler attributes including legacy string forms, records per-vector metadata such as save policy, nesting mode, security level, and reset helper names, emits vector and jump-table sections at file end, and provides queries for whether a function is an ISR or critical ISR, thereby owning the backend’s attribute-driven ISR metadata and assembly emission logic.
